meta.title: African Market for Sellers
meta.description: Manage your shop, branches, products and orders

home.tagline: Manage your shop, branches, catalogue and customers.
home.steps: Create your shop · Add branches on the map · List products · Get verified

auth.phoneTitle: Sign in or create an account
auth.phoneWhy: Save shops, chat with sellers and track orders. Browsing never needs an account.
auth.phoneHint: We’ll send a 6-digit code on WhatsApp. Home-country numbers work too.
auth.countrySearch: Search by country, code or dial code
auth.countryNone: No country matches. Try its name, its code (NG) or its dial code (234).
auth.termsLead: By continuing you agree to our
auth.codeSentWhatsapp: We sent a 6-digit code on WhatsApp to
auth.profileBody: Sellers see your first name when you message them. Nothing else is shared.
auth.name: Your name
auth.nameRequired: Enter your name so sellers know who is writing.
auth.agree: I agree to the Terms and Privacy policy
auth.marketing: Send me offers and new shops on WhatsApp
auth.marketingHint: Optional. Turn off any time in Settings.
auth.emailWhy: Use this if you would rather not sign in with a phone number.
auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.forgotBody: Enter the email address of your account and we’ll send a code to reset it.

shops.title: Your shops
shops.welcomeBody: Customers near you find you by distance and message you on WhatsApp. Setting up takes about ten minutes: your shop, where it is, when you are open and how to reach you.
shops.loadFailed: Your shops could not be loaded.

setup.label: Shop setup
setup.notFound: This shop was not found, or you are not one of its team.
setup.detailsIntro: Customers see this first. Write it in the languages you can; English or Arabic is enough to start.
setup.name: Shop name
setup.namePlaceholder: For example Mama Nkechi African Foods
setup.descriptionHint: What you sell or do, and what makes it special.
setup.originsHint: Customers can search by country. Choose up to five.
setup.branchIntro: Put the pin on your door: customers are sent to it, and search measures distance from it.
setup.branchNameHint: For example the area: Al Nahda.
setup.makaniHint: 10 digits on the blue plate at your building entrance (Dubai).
setup.pinHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it.
setup.pinNoMap: Use your location while you are at the shop, or start from the emirate and adjust later.
setup.findPlacePlaceholder: For example Al Nahda Pond Park
setup.noPlaces: No places found in the UAE.
setup.placesUnavailable: Searching for places is not working right now. Drag the pin instead.
setup.locationDenied: Location is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser, or move the pin by hand.
setup.locationFailed: Your location could not be found. Move the pin by hand.
setup.howServe: How do customers get your goods?
setup.radiusHint: How far from the pin you deliver. You can draw an exact area later.
setup.moneyInvalid: Enter an amount in dirhams, like 10 or 12.50.
setup.hoursIntro: Customers see whether you are open now. Add a second period for a break in the day.
setup.contactsIntro: Customers tap these on your page. A WhatsApp number is what most people use.
setup.phoneInvalid: This is not a valid number for the country chosen.
setup.contactRequired: Give at least one way to reach you.
setup.photosIntro: A logo and a few clear photos of the shop front and what you sell get more customers to contact you.
setup.verifyIntro: We check who you are before your shop appears to customers. It takes a few minutes with your Emirates ID or passport.
setup.byRadius: Within a distance of the shop
setup.byArea: In an area I draw on the map
setup.byAreaHint: For areas that are not a circle: along a road, or a few neighbourhoods.
setup.areaHint: Drag the corners to fit your delivery area. Drag a midpoint to add a corner.
setup.areaRequired: Shape the area you deliver to on the map.
setup.mainBranchHint: Shown first on your page, and where your shop's own contacts point.

hours.problemsame-time: Opening and closing times are the same.
hours.problemtoo-many: At most three periods a day.

overview.productsHint: What you sell, its prices and where it is in stock.
overview.insightsHint: How often customers tapped WhatsApp, call or email.
overview.settingsHint: Your shop page, branches, language and account.

photos.logoHint: A square picture works best; it is shown in a circle.
photos.galleryHint: Up to {max} photos: the shop front, inside, and what you sell. The first one is the cover.
photos.wrongType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
photos.tooLarge: This picture is larger than {mb} MB.
photos.tooMany: Only the first pictures were added: a shop has at most {max}.

verify.listingdraft: Not sent for review yet. Customers cannot see your shop.
verify.listingpending: We are reviewing your shop, usually within two working days. We will tell you when it is live.
verify.listingverified: Your shop is live: customers can find and contact you.
verify.listingrejected: Your shop needs changes before it can go live. Fix what is below, then send it again.
verify.listingsuspended: Your shop is hidden from customers. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
verify.kycHelpnone: You will take a photo of your Emirates ID or passport and a selfie with our verification partner. Your documents stay with them; we only learn the result.
verify.kycHelppending: Your documents are being checked. This usually takes a few minutes.
verify.kycHelpfailed: The check did not go through. You can try again, with a clear photo in good light.
verify.licenceHelp: If you have one, add it now: once we check it, your shop page shows your registered name. You will need it for online orders later. Home-based sellers can use their home business permit.
verify.issuingAuthorityPlaceholder: For example Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
verify.licenceFileHint: A PDF or a clear photo.
verify.licenceFileRequired: Add a copy of the licence.
verify.licenceFileType: Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
verify.licenceFileSize: This file is larger than {mb} MB.
verify.sendHelp: Once your identity check has started, send the shop. We review it and tell you when it is live, or what to change.
verify.missingcontact: Add a way for customers to reach you.

branches.title: Branches
branches.notFound: This branch was not found. It may have been removed.
branches.specialDaysHint: Days that differ from your usual week, like Eid, Ramadan evenings or a national holiday. They replace the usual hours on that date.
branches.dateRequired: Choose a date from today on.
branches.removeHint: Customers will no longer see it. Products listed only here will not show at any branch.
branches.removeOnly: This is your shop's only branch. Add another before removing it.
branches.removeBody: Customers will no longer see this branch. This cannot be undone.
branches.removePrimary: This is your main branch: your oldest other branch becomes the main one. This cannot be undone.

products.title: Products
products.notFound: This product was not found, or it belongs to another shop.
products.notVerifiedHint: Customers see your live products once your shop is verified. You can prepare them now.
products.statusHintdraft: Customers cannot see it yet. Publish it when it is ready.
products.statusHintpending_review: We check it before customers see it. We will tell you when it is live.
products.statusHintactive: Customers can see it at the branches that sell it.
products.statusHinthidden: Customers cannot see it. Publish it again whenever you like.
products.statusHintrejected: It needs changes before it can go live. Fix what is below, then send it again.
products.emptyHint: Add what you sell, with its price and the branches that have it.
products.reviewedHint: Products in this category are checked by our team before they show.
products.descriptionHint: What it is, how it is used, the brand.
products.photosHint: Up to {max} photos on a plain background. The first one is the cover.
products.tooManyPhotos: Only the first photos were added: a product has at most {max}.
products.onRequestHint: Leave it empty to show "Price on request".
products.compareAtHint: Shown crossed out, for a reduced price.
products.optionName: What do the versions differ by?
products.optionNameHint: One word that fits them all.
products.optionNamePlaceholder: For example Size, Weight or Colour
products.addVersions: It comes in several sizes or versions
products.foodIntro: Food sold here must be safe and legal in the UAE. Our team checks food before it shows.
products.foodPackagedHint: With the maker, country of origin, ingredients and expiry date.
products.foodNoRestricted: It is not a restricted item
products.foodNoRestrictedHint: Not fresh meat or fish, not unlabelled goods, not herbal medicine.
products.foodRegistrationHint: For example from Dubai Municipality's Montaji, if it has one.
products.whereHint: The branches that have it, whether it is in stock, and a branch price if it differs.
products.problemtitle: Give it a name in English or Arabic.
products.problemoptionName: Say what the versions differ by, for example Size.
products.problemoptionTwice: Two versions have the same name.
products.problemprice: Enter a price in dirhams, for example 25 or 12.50.
products.problemcompareAt: The old price must be higher than the price.
products.problemdeclaration: Confirm both statements and say how it is kept.
products.problemquantity: Enter a whole number, or leave it empty.
products.problembranchPrice: Enter a price in dirhams, or leave it empty.
products.removeHint: It goes from your shop and its photos are deleted.
products.removeBody: Customers will no longer see it. This cannot be undone.

insights.title: Customer contacts
insights.intro: Each time a customer taps WhatsApp, call or email on your page or a product.
insights.otherProduct: A product no longer in your shop
insights.noneBody: Customers reach you from your shop page and product pages. Complete photos and prices help them decide.
insights.footnote: Counts are taps on the buttons, by Dubai day. We cannot see whether a call or message followed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.branchesHint: Where you are and when you are open.
settings.verificationHint: Identity check, trade licence and review.
settings.viewPublic: See your shop as customers do
settings.languageHint: For this app and the messages we send you.
settings.dataHint: Download or delete your personal data.
